subject: Orchid Tech / Redwood - SI skill sprint onboarding & lab pact
messages:
From: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orchidtech.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid / Redwood SI collaboration — proposed skill sprint

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier this week. Orchid Tech is keen to become a certified Systems Integrator for Redwood deployments — we see a lot of demand from our customers to integrate Redwood inference across private clouds and hybrid stacks.

We'd like to propose a 3-day "Skill Sprint" (read: hands-on technical enablement) for a cross-functional Orchid cohort (2 engineers, 1 pre-sales, 1 delivery lead). Goals:
- get them able to run a private deployment day-1
- complete the Redwood runbook labs (runtime tuning, KV cache, canary rollouts)
- certify at a basic delivery level so we can start joint opportunities

Can Redwood run a session the week of May 22? We can host (SF office) or take it remote. Attaching a short partner intro deck + suggested dates.

Attachments: Orchid_Onboarding_Deck.pdf (PDF, 980KB)

Thanks,
Liam O'Rourke
Head of Alliances | Orchid Tech
liam@orchidtech.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orchidtech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid / Redwood SI collaboration — proposed skill sprint

Liam — great to hear this. We're energized about Orchid as a partner.

High level plan (proposed):
Day 0: prework + account setup (IAM, vpc peering checklist)
Day 1: private deployment lab (onprem/VPC option) + runtime walk-through
Day 2: performance tuning (batching, quantization profiles) + observability deep-dive
Day 3: joint delivery patterns + handoff / certification exercise

I attached a draft "SI Skill Sprint Syllabus" and our runbook excerpt (redwood-runbook-v1.md). Tessa, can you confirm facilitator availability the week of May 22? Marissa, can you own logistics (venue vs. remote + trainer staffing)? Soojin — will need a short tech checklist from you for prework.

Next steps:
1) Liam — confirm preferred format (onsite SF or remote) and attendee names
2) Redwood to send final syllabus + MOU for the enablement (DocuSign link)
3) Lock dates & internal resource owners

Attachments: SI_Skill_Sprint_Syllabus.pdf (PDF, 412KB); redwood-runbook-v1.md (text, 28KB)

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid / Redwood SI collaboration — proposed skill sprint

Marcus / team — happy to take logistics. Quick notes:
- We can run a hybrid format: 2 days remote labs (Zoom + cloud sandboxes), day 3 in-person at Redwood SF for capstone if Orchid will travel.
- Trainer: I recommend pairing Tessa (facilitation) + an engineer for the hands-on labs. Budget estimate: $6k/day for on-site facilitation + travel (if onsite).
- Travel windows: May 23–25 works for our field team; May 29–31 is a backup.

I'll draft an ops checklist and attendee RSVP template. Marcus — I'll need the roster and the sandbox links to include in the attendee prework.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid / Redwood SI collaboration — proposed skill sprint

Folks — added technical prework checklist below (short):
- Access: confirm IAM roles + test service account (instructions in runbook v1)
- Sample workload: prepare a 2k token prompt set and expected latency targets
- Hardware: for onsite lab bring at least one T4 instance for demo, otherwise we'll use cloud GPU pool
- Telemetry: confirm access to a staging Console org & the tracing hooks sample app

I'll stand up the staging sandbox and share a Cloud sandbox invite link by Friday. Also: we should include a short "regression/quality" mini-lesson — common gotchas when teams move from dev to production (KV-cache misses, prefix caching).

On the certification rubric — propose a practical exercise: deploy a canary, simulate a load spike, and demonstrate fallback to model-variant. If they pass, we issue a "Redwood SI: Foundation" badge.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

From: Priya Menon <priya@orchidtech.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Rourke <liam@orchidtech.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchid / Redwood SI collaboration — proposed skill sprint

Marcus / Marissa — thanks, this looks great. Orchid prefers May 23–25 (onsite SF) so long as we can get travel support for two engineers. We agree with the syllabus and the certification exercise.

Request: please send the final syllabus and runbook excerpt plus the DocuSign MOU. We'll sign and return. Also can you add a 30-minute executive alignment call on May 22 to review scope (Marcus + Liam + our Head of Delivery)?

Attachments: none (we will sign the DocuSign packet once received)

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Partnerships Manager | Orchid Tech
priya@orchidtech.ai
